title: MessageSearchQuery
$comment: The first delivery is scoped to one already-authorized Conversation. The authenticated runtime must encrypt and authenticate each continuation cursor and bind it to the Punk, Workspace, Conversation, a domain-separated keyed binding of the normalized query, token algorithm, internal position tuple, limit, and cursor version. A Punk id, Conversation id, Message id, plain query hash, plaintext, or opaque index token must never be visible in the cursor.
